read.thesis: IBM Q3 2024 call: software growth accelerated to 10% and FCF guided above $12B, but consulting flat and Infrastructure down 7% on product-cycle timing; no supply-side capacity signals.

triggers.label: Software growth accelerated to 10%
triggers.quote: Software growth accelerated to 10%, with strength across our key platforms of Red Hat, automation, data and AI, and transaction processing.

triggers.label: Productivity savings raised to $3.5B
triggers.quote: we now believe we can achieve approximately $3.5 billion in annual run rate savings by the end of 2024, up from $3 billion.

triggers.label: Consulting flat; signings down second quarter
triggers.quote: our overall signings declined for the second consecutive quarter as we wrapped on record third quarter signings from last year.

triggers.label: Infrastructure down 7%, IBM Z down 19%
triggers.quote: IBM Z revenue declined 19% in what is now the tenth quarter of z16 availability.

guidance.quote: we remain confident in delivering greater than $12 billion of free cash flow for the year
we are raising our expectation for operating pretax margin expansion to about 1 point year-to-year

guidance.value: similar to Q3, weaker end of low-single digit for year
guidance.quote: This represents the weaker end of our prior expectations of low-single digit revenue growth for the year.

guidance.value: about 1 point impact for full year
guidance.quote: we now expect the infrastructure to be about a 1 point impact to IBM for the full year.
we now believe we can achieve approximately $3.5 billion in annual run rate savings by the end of 2024, up from $3 billion.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Free cash flow raised in July
prior_guidance_check.quote: We remain confident in our free cash flow guidance which we raised in July

prior_guidance_check.metric: Operating pretax margin expansion over 50 bps in 2024
prior_guidance_check.quote: Year-to-date, operating pretax margin is up 150 basis points, well ahead of our guidance provided in July of over 50 basis points of improvement in 2024.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Consulting low-single digit revenue growth for year
prior_guidance_check.quote: This represents the weaker end of our prior expectations of low-single digit revenue growth for the year.

red_flags.label: Consulting signings down two quarters
red_flags.quote: our overall signings declined for the second consecutive quarter as we wrapped on record third quarter signings from last year.

red_flags.label: Gen AI deals lower yield, 3-4 pts
red_flags.quote: about 3 to 4 points less yield than traditional book of business overall.

evasions.topic: FCF growth quantification for 2025 (Benitez-style high-single-digit question)
evasions.quote: I'm not going to get into the specifics as you would probably not expect me to about actual quantification.

evasions.topic: Consulting inflection timing and Gen AI cannibalisation
evasions.quote: Consulting is going to be more of a second half '25 play as we move forward.
